name: token-todo
description: A user-invoked Codex skill for converting an eligible, time-bounded resource envelope into current-value engineering progress without quota or billing automation.

interface.shortDescription: Turn eligible expiring capacity into safe engineering progress
interface.longDescription: Build a resource-and-work contract, select maintenance with a present-tense project reason, and execute only explicitly approved bounded slices with checkpoints, verification, and rollback. Token Todo does not inspect account quotas, monitor resets, consume paid or shared capacity, or run background work.
defaultPrompt: Use Token Todo to build a current-value, bounded maintenance plan from a user-stated resource and time budget.
Use Token Todo to curate this project's low-risk backlog without reading account quota data.
